setting: An original illustrated early autumn landscape inspired by Inari and northern Finnish Lapland
prompt: Edit this children's picture-book background into a landscape inspired by the northern boreal woods around Inari, Finnish Lapland, in early autumn after sunset. Retain the 16:9 framing, open horizon, exact mint-green and lilac aurora ribbon and indigo sky, few stars, left-hand shallow brook and its understated stepping stones, and the existing soft gouache and paper texture. Replace all the generic rounded yellow-green park trees along both edges and in the distance with these specific trees: mature native Scots pines (Pinus sylvestris), with tall warm red-brown upper trunks and sparse irregular high crowns in blue-green needle clusters on outward branches; and short multi-stemmed mountain birches (Betula pubescens subsp. czerepanovii), with twisting pale grey-white bark, dark horizontal marks, fine branches, and small gold and muted green autumn leaves. Make both clearly recognizable at the edges even with a mascot and graphic overlay: a pale curved mountain birch trunk close to the far left edge, more birch and pine in the distance, and tall open-crowned Scots pines at the far right edge. Scots pine crowns are open and irregular, not layered Christmas tree cones. Replace the large garden flowers and uniform turf with softly brushed low moss and grasses, tiny low lingonberry bushes with deep red berries near the bottom corners, and a few pale branching reindeer-lichen patches on the drier ground by grey rounded stones. Keep most of the lawn-like clearing quiet, softly textured, medium-light sage green, with dry unobstructed space for a cartoon bear in the left quarter and a broad teaching board on the right. Keep cool autumn dusk light, soft texture and cheerful series style. This is a standalone background plate. No characters, animals, text, signs, letters, numerals, panels, logos, or watermark.
